{{Quote|Waiting for ''this''?''"<br />"''Yes! I mean, ''no!'' I mean, I don't know what you mean!|Quinlan Vos and the Neimoidian|<ref name="Republic 49">[[Republic 49|''Republic'' 49]]</ref>}}
A '''Neimoidian male''' worked for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While waiting on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] to pass on a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] from the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Zenex]], he was [[Mind trick/Legends|tricked]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], who had secretly copied the disc before giving it to the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] in Zenex's place.
